concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-online-payments-account-updater-real-time-account-updater]] — Adyen Real Time Account Updater guide for eligible in-processing card updates and retry, optional response data, statuses, and test scenarios (webpage snapshot, 2026-09-15).
warnings: The existing Account Updater overview source describes returned card information broadly; this detailed guide qualifies payment-response card data as optional/configured, with full PAN on a separate fully PCI-compliant, Support-enabled path.
